entries.o: <fe><02><09><65><33><33><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I've sworn to protect\nRiviera and the Sprites!
<fe><02><09><65><33><33><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Well, you would never\nbe able to understand...
<fe><02><0a><36><38><34><61><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Just don't die so easily,\nor it won't be any fun.

<fe><02><0a><36><38><34><61><5f><30><30><34><35><00>You were nothing but a
nuisance to me.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><34><61><5f><30><30><34><36><00>Thinking, worrying,
doubting...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><34><61><5f><30><30><34><37><00>Watching you, I felt
something similar to anger.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><34><61><5f><30><30><34><38><00>But I realize now that
that wasn't anger...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><34><61><5f><30><30><34><39><00>I may actually have been
envious of you.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><34><61><5f><30><30><35><30><00>You, who was as weak as
a newborn child...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><34><61><5f><30><30><35><31><00>...returned far stronger
than thought possible.
<fe><02><0a><36><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Riviera isn't a sacrifice\nfor Asgard.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>That's what I think.\nThat's what I believe.
<fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><31><31><00>I know... But it will slow\ndown the intruder.
<fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><31><33><00>I'm sorry, but there is\nno time to grieve...

<fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><31><35><00>There is nothing left to
protect Yggdrasil.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><31><36><00>You must do as Ledah told
you...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Travel to the Maze of Shadows
and defeat Hector...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Just as Seth, the Sealed
One, and I are opposites,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><31><39><00>so, too, are the Yggdrasil
and the Maze of Shadows.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><32><30><00>If the Yggdrasil's powers
have weakened,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><32><31><00>the Maze of Shadows must
be weak as well.
<fe><02><0a><36><38><31><61><5f><30><30><32><32><00>See for yourself. That\nis the Maze of Shadows.
<fe><02><0a><36><39><33><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>H-Hmph! I'm not afraid of\nyou, black-winged monsters!
<fe><02><0a><36><39><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Huh? Hey, you are! Geez,\ndon't scare me like that!
<fe><02><0a><36><39><33><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>I hear it only grows in\nthe purest water.

<fe><02><0a><36><39><34><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>I feel some sort of pulse\ncoming from it.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><36><39><34><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>It's like something is\nseeping out of Yggdrasil.
<fe><02><0a><36><39><34><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>I feel something horrible\nis going to happen.

The wetlands that
extend out at the
bottom of Yggdrasil.
Gregarious plants
grow in the water.

Stone blocks spiral
around the giant
pillar that rises
from the center of
Yggdrasil.

A group of floating
stones known as
Manalith are strung
out in a spiral-like
fashion.

Circular gardens float
about, encompassing
the trees over and
over at the center of
Yggdrasil.

The main tree that
grows in the center
of Yggdrasil. It is
said that it gives
life to all.

Created by the gods,
it protects and
controls Yggdrasil.
There are three
Aquariums total.

The top area of
Yggdrasil. Holy blue
light fills the space.
Crystal fibers spread
out like a maze.

The top of Yggdrasil.
The monolith holding
the wisdom of the gods
lies here in the
sacred light.

The first Aquarium
now lies in ruin.
A powerful impact
has caused the place
to start crumbling.
<fe><02><0a><37><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I never imagined coming\nback here like this...
<fe><02><0a><37><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Looks like we need to beat\n'em to get past.

<fe><02><0a><37><31><33><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>I'd rather forget the last\ntime I passed through here...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><31><33><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>All I thought about back\nthen was Asgard...
<fe><02><0a><37><31><33><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>You always seem to know\nthe right thing to say.
It's a <fc><4b> Chip...\nWhat should I do with it?
I hope I don't look too\nmuscular...
I can feel the power surge\nthrough me.
Hmhmhm... Now, I can use\neven more powerful spells!
Can I use magic, now, like\nCierra?
I hope with this new power\nI can be of service...
I won't lose to no demons!
I hope I won't get hurt\nanymore...
There's more to fighting\nthan taking the offensive.
I feel as if I could fly\nagain.
I feel lighter...\n(Maybe I lost weight<a2><51>)
I shall make good use of\nthis newfound speed.
<fe><02><0a><37><32><32><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>But is it safe? It feels\nlike it's gonna give.
<fe><02><0a><37><32><32><61><5f><30><30><30><38><00>It must be because of that\nround weapon they had...

<fe><02><0a><37><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>It must be that round\nthing they're using.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>There's a loud bang, and\nthen the floor crumbles.
<fe><02><0a><37><32><34><61><5f><30><30><31><31><00>I guess we have no choice\nbut to fight them.
<fe><02><0a><37><32><34><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>Feel the power of the bomb.\nWe'll blow you to bits!
<fe><02><0a><37><32><35><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I've had enough high-wire\nacting for one day.
<fe><02><0a><37><32><35><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I don't wanna see that\nround thing ever again!
<fe><02><0a><37><33><32><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Somewhere on this island,\nSeth is being summoned...
<fe><02><0a><37><33><32><61><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Then the Retribution might\noccur... We have to hurry.
<fe><02><0a><37><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Finally. But I guess we\ndid fall once on the way.
<fe><02><0a><37><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Then the Retribution might\noccur... We have to hurry.
<fe><02><0a><37><33><32><63><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Finally. But I guess we did\nfall a few times on the way.
<fe><02><0a><37><33><33><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>I'd just fly up there, but\nthen I'd be an easy target.
<fe><02><0a><37><33><33><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>We have no choice but to\ndefeat them.
<fe><02><0a><37><33><34><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>I don't know... I feel like\nsomeone's watching me.
<fe><02><0a><37><33><34><61><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Not you. Someone I need to\nbe more worried about.
<fe><02><0a><37><34><31><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>Yeah. It's like the ground\nis clinging to your feet.
<fe><02><0a><37><34><32><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>Ein, the path... I think\nwe're slowly sinking.
<fe><02><0a><37><34><32><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>We can't turn back now.\nJust keep moving.

<fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>Seth's resurrection is
going just as planned...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>A few more souls, and it
will be complete.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Master Hector's ambition
shall be realized.
<fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>Are you insane!? How many\nwill you sacrifice?
<fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>No, the gods would not have\nwished for such a thing!

<fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>What do you want from
the gods?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>Power is not good or evil.
The strong should rule.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>Angels will live in bliss
under Master Hector.
<fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>The Grim Angels are not\nHector's soldiers.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>They are the executors of\nthe gods' will!
<fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><37><00>When you became a Grim\nAngel, you also swore<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>that you'd be the blade\nof judgment.
<fe><02><0a><37><34><35><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>No, I only pledged my\nallegiance to the gods!
<fe><02><0a><37><35><32><61><5f><30><30><30><36><00>My village is gone, so I'm\nnot sure what I'll do.
<fe><02><0a><37><35><32><61><5f><30><30><30><38><00>(Why can't I just tell him\nI want to go with him...)
<fe><02><0a><37><35><32><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>They can't be Ledah's...\nThey must be Malice's.
<fe><02><0a><37><35><33><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>What are you gonna do when\nthis's all over?
<fe><02><0a><37><35><33><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>I wanna go home to Elendia\nand play with everyone!
<fe><02><0a><37><35><34><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Fia, sorry it came to this...\nSorry I got you involved.
<fe><02><0a><37><35><34><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Have you been blaming\nyourself all this time?

<fe><02><0a><37><35><31><61><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I hardly feel like I'm\nwalking...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><35><31><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>It seems like we're being\npulled into the darkness...
<fe><02><0a><37><35><31><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>I'm the adult here<fc><4a> I\nshould set a good example.
I'll fight for the sake of\nRiviera!

<fe><02><0a><37><36><32><61><5f><30><30><30><30><00>So the Dark Progenitors
are like pre-demons, huh?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><36><32><61><5f><30><30><30><31><00>They're evil, but they
still get to be reborn...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><36><32><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Well, what about us? What
happens to us when we die?
<fe><02><0a><37><36><32><61><5f><30><30><31><36><00>And also, I was able to\nmeet all of you.
<fe><02><0a><37><36><32><61><5f><30><30><32><34><00>Aren't you overreacting\na bit, Serene?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><36><32><61><5f><30><30><32><35><00>He was just trying to\nlighten the mood.

<fe><02><0a><37><36><35><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>No wonder this place is
called a maze...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><36><35><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Is there some sort of
secret to it?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><36><35><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>All we know is that demons
who die are reborn here...
I won't run!\nI'm a Grim Angel!
I'm not afraid of death.<fe><00>If that's my fate,\nthen so be it!
<fe><02><0a><37><37><31><62><5f><30><30><31><34><00>I can't even tell if\nwe're going forward...
<fe><02><0a><37><37><32><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>I couldn't have made it\nthis far without you.
<fe><02><0a><37><37><32><61><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Really... You were more help\nthan you can imagine.
<fe><02><0a><37><37><33><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>(Ein, you seem stronger\nand more confident now.)
<fe><02><0a><37><37><35><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>Now, you plan to destroy\nall of Riviera!?
I have to keep my promise\nto Ursula...<fe><00>I can't fail!!
<fe><02><0a><37><38><31><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>If you're fighting demons,\nthen I wanna help!

<fe><02><0a><37><38><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>I don't feel any heat from
the flames around here...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><38><32><62><5f><30><30><30><36><00>Are we still in the real
world?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><38><32><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Or am I starting to
imagine things?
<fe><02><0a><37><38><34><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>Complete the ritual!\nFor the sake of Asgard!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><37><38><34><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>Take what is rightfully\nyours!
<fe><02><0a><37><38><34><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>Alright. This will be\nthe dawn of a new era!
